user_report: Oy vey, nameplate receiver finished and I tested it, and now I have lateral X movement, but throughout that X movement there is still bowing. It's like the wings are being awkwardly held down in a way that bows the rest.
assessment: The body-X relief trial permits lateral movement but leaves the bow unresolved. Wing thickness/angle constraint, Z-end contact and seating-plane distortion remain unseparated. User describes a holding-down effect at the wings; this is not a measured contact location.
scope: Physical feedback for this receiver with the existing nameplate; no new global clearance rule or dimension accepted.
